function.name: games_update_find
function.description: Find the latest updates or patches for a specific game on a specified gaming platform. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

platform.description: The gaming platform, e.g. Xbox, Playstation, PC.

region.description: The region of the update (optional, default is 'global')

function.name: games_reviews_find
function.description: Find reviews for a specific game. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

region.description: The region where the reviews are coming from (optional, default is 'global')

function.name: games_price_find
function.description: Find the current price for a specific game on a specified gaming platform. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

platform.description: The gaming platform, e.g. Xbox, Playstation, PC.
